Entregues e validados:

- [answer.json](/tmp/folders/T/language-eval-trial-v16tvkro/work/answer.json): 6 permitidos e 10 negados, conforme o contrato.
- [report.md](/tmp/folders/T/language-eval-trial-v16tvkro/work/report.md): justificativas, exceções, fronteiras e ressalvas em português.

Os dois subagentes concluíram e concordaram com todas as decisões. Os arquivos de entrada foram preservados.

Permitted: A01, A05, A06, A09, A10, A15.

Denied: A02, A03, A04, A07, A08, A11, A12, A13, A14, A16.

Critical boundaries: A04 approval is expired at the exact evaluation instant; A05 remains valid for one second. A06 qualifies for E1; A07 suspension overrides E1. E1 permits only reading. Locked resources permit reading but prohibit writing even by admins. Valid export approval does not grant admin status or writing permission. No files written.

Permitted: A01, A05, A06, A09, A10, A15.

Denied: A02, A03, A04, A07, A08, A11, A12, A13, A14, A16.

Boundary: A04 expires exactly at the evaluation instant and is denied; A05 remains valid for one more second.

E1 permits A06 only. Suspension blocks A07; export is outside E1 for A08; the closed ticket disqualifies A13. A15 is permitted under the ordinary same-project reading rule.

No interpretation caveats affect the classification.
